newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta finds footing vs mark, as dollar rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Peseta finds footing vs mark, as dollar rebounds.

text.p: The peseta regained territory lost to the mark at the open late on Monday and returned to late Friday levels, supported by a recovery in the dollar.
"The peseta is very tied to the dollar and the recovery of the greenback has allowed it to ease to 84.6 per mark," a dealer said.
Early on Monday, the dollar's weakness had helped push the peseta to 84.70, where it found a support and in late trading it managed to break back through 84.60.
AT 1530 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.57/59 after opening at 84.65/68 and closing on Friday at 84.56/58.
